items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: So I thought, oh, I'll call -- the fellow that married Maxine Sullivan Sawburn.

ctx.x: Yeah, and Dick Wellstood and all of them. But Dennis Strong, he was the drummer, and we needed a piano player. So now they wanted -- asked me to get a piano soprano. So I thought, oh, I'll call -- the fellow that married Maxine Sullivan Sawburn.
